items.title: George Mitchell Interview, 1959-07-01
items.q: Well, yes. Oh, sure you would have known him later, anyway. Was he here when you came up? Yeah, Freddie Keppard was here, yeah

ctx.x: Really was. In jazz playing. Did their band sound much different than the music in Louisville?

That it's different type, or? Well, yes. South the same? Yes, uh, the New Orleans band, and, we, I, I, I, I, because when I, I came to Chicago and heard Joe and those boys from New Orleans, why, I, I, I just, I never heard nothing like that. Them guys out, I, I, I. Really liked it. Yeah. Uh-huh. Yeah. Uh, I, I, I think it was, it was different. Because one thing, I think, uh, Borgon, really, uh, it didn't, wasn't, it was, uh, I don't know, didn't have the, the style. The style was different, you know? Was there a…
How did Joe and, when the, when Louis Armstrong came up to join him, how did they compare? Was Joe was powerful, or more powerful, and Louis, or how?
